game.title: Banned Books Museum Challenge
game.description: Explore the Banned Books Museum and find the book that shook the world!
game.author: Andrew Lih
game.prompt: Click on the book that caused a fatwa to be issued against the author.
game.hint: Look for a book by an author who was forced into hiding.

answer.label: The Satanic Verses
answer.successMessage: This is The Satanic Verses by Salman Rushdie, published in 1988. Iran's Ayatollah Khomeini issued a fatwa calling for Rushdie's death in 1989, forcing the author into hiding under police protection for nearly a decade. The novel sparked worldwide debates about free speech, blasphemy, and the limits of artistic expression.

decoys.label: Other exhibit
decoys.message: That exhibit is interesting, but it didn't spark an international incident. Keep looking for something more controversial.

decoys.label: Nearby shelf
decoys.message: Close, but that's not the one. The book we're looking for was banned in multiple countries and its author lived under a death threat.

decoys.label: Far wall
decoys.message: That area has some banned books, but none quite as infamous as the one that caused a fatwa.
